title: 029 - Collapse Spaces
prompt: Fix the bug so the program trim the sample text and collapse repeated spaces into bug fix arena and prints exactly `bug fix arena`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function collapseSpaces(int $year, int $month, int $day): string
{
    return strval($year) . "-" . strval($month) . "-" . str_pad(strval($day), 2, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function collapseSpaces(int $year, int $month, int $day): string
{
    return strval($year) . "-" . str_pad(strval($month), 2, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT) . "-" . str_pad(strval($day), 2, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT);
}
explanation: The broken code removes edge spaces but leaves repeated inner spaces. Collapsing multiple spaces fixes the output.
